title: Capability contracts
description: The capability registry vocabulary, exact capability versions and the capability lock (05 §3, §6, §11; 09 §21). The registry itself is protocol/capability_registry.json.

CapabilityKey.description: A capability key (05 §6), lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters. A capability contract is key@version.

CapabilityVersion.description: A capability contract version (05 §6): a positive integer. key@version is immutable in meaning once published; a breaking change takes a new version (05 §6, 'Capability version immutability').

CapabilityVersions.description: Exact capability pins, capability key to version (05 §3 requires.capabilities; 05 §6). A map, so one version per key: the canonical decoder rejects a repeated key, and canonical encoding sorts keys.

CapabilityLock.description: The exact capability lock of a compiled cartridge or deployment (05 §3 'Compatibility versions', §6, §11): every capability version it executes. capability_lock_hash (09 §21) is hash(lock) under loka-numeric-v1; format is the hash domain tag, and any change to this format takes a new tag. Resolving a manifest's requirements and registry dependencies into a lock is the compiler's job (R4).

CapabilitySpec.description: One registry entry (05 §6): a capability version, its portability, and its semantic residency from the residency matrix (05 §6 'Capability semantic residency matrix'). Portability limits residency (this table is the PM's adopted reading of 05 §6, not spec text): a portable capability is a portable semantic foundation or portable capability implementation, server_only is a Realm-only semantic capability, client_presentation_only is client presentation; authority-host coordination and authoring/certification are never capabilities (05 §6). A null residency is not yet classified. Commands, events, effects and policies join by name once their registries exist (R3 PR 3).

oneOf.description: Runs on every host, Story and Realm (05 §6).
Realm-only; an offline_private cartridge cannot depend on it for gameplay (05 §6).
Presentation only, never gameplay legality or authoritative mutation (05 §6).
